title: Custom Crafts
description: Custom Crafts is a simple QoL datapack that adds fair, vanilla-friendly recipes for un-crafting, re-dyeing, and hard-to-get items — no new blocks, just smarter crafting.
body: Custom Crafts is a lightweight datapack that fills in Minecraft’s missing recipes, making crafting more fair and flexible. It adds reversible recipes (like turning stairs back into planks), re-dyeing options for wool, and crafts for uncraftable items such as notch apples, name tags, and sea pickles. Designed as a pure quality-of-life upgrade, it doesn’t add new blocks or items—just smarter, more balanced recipes that feel like they should have been in vanilla all along.
